signatureEngine.name: 家政员
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 安心家用轮锯
refinements.description: 位于后场时，装备者的能量自动回复提升0.45点/秒；[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，装备者造成的物理伤害提升3%，最多叠加15层，持续1秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by 0.45/s. When an EX Special Attack hits an enemy, the equipper's Physical DMG increases by 3%, stacking up to 15 times and lasting 1s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：扫除开始
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
在第三、第五段中连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button during the 3rd and 5th hits to extend the chainsaw slash attack.

special.name: 特殊技：强力清扫
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行持续斩击，随后引爆电锯，造成物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：小心裙角
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行持续强力斩击，随后引爆电锯，造成大量物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人，并随招式命中目标，逐渐消耗能量；
回旋斩击期间拥有无敌效果；
持续斩击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack at the cost of Energy if the attack connects.
Character is invulnerable during the spinning slash.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the extended slash, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：[舍]
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，随后引爆电锯，造成物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front before detonating her chainsaw, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：抱歉…
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：非、非常抱歉！
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：应急措施
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，随后引爆电锯，造成物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front before detonating her chainsaw, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：请、请让我来！
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：快速清扫
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，随后引爆电锯，造成物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以使用电锯持续斩击敌人；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes against enemies in front followed by an explosive chainsaw, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold to extend the chainsaw slash attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 连点或长按后，可琳使用电锯持续斩击敌人时，招式造成的伤害提升37.5%。
facts.textEn: After holding or tapping repeatedly, when Corin unleashes a continuous extended slash with her Chainsaw, the skill's DMG increases by 37.5%.

cinema.name: 开放性创伤
cinema.description: [连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，可琳对目标造成的伤害提升12%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Corin's Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, her DMG against the target increases by 12% for 15s.

cinema.name: 裂解效应
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]命中敌人时，目标的物理伤害抗性下降0.5%，最多叠加20层，持续5秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Corin's EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the target's Physical RES is reduced by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

cinema.name: 初级女仆
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 战场随侍
cinema.description: 发动[快速支援]、[招架支援]或[连携技]时，可琳回复7.2点能量，16秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Corin uses a Quick Assist, Defensive Assist, or Chain Attack, she recovers 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 16s.

cinema.name: 特勤女仆
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 厚积薄发
cinema.description: 持续斩击命中敌人时，可琳获得1层充能（最多40层）；在[闪避反击]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[快速支援]、[支援突击]中，引爆电锯命中敌人时，消耗所有充能，每层充能使本次攻击额外造成可琳3%攻击力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.
